references.text: The Levites received cities to live in and the pasturelands around the cities for their livestock and cattle, as a parallel to the provision in Numbers.
Describes how the Levites did not receive an inheritance of land, but cities to live in with pasturelands for their livestock.
The pasturelands around the Levitical cities could not be sold, as they were the Levites' possession forever—an elaboration on the provision regarding pasturelands.
Reiteration that the Levites received cities with associated pasturelands within their territories.
Ezekiel's vision includes pasturelands around the sanctuary, reflecting the principle of open land surrounding the Levitical cities.
The immediate context commanding the Israelites to give the Levites cities to live in with pasturelands around them.
